title: Beyond the Early Era of EVs: Evidence from the Staggered Rollout of the HOV Lane Network in California

title: Colluding Against Environmental Regulation
abstract: We study collusion among firms against imperfectly monitored environmental regulation. Firms increase variable profits by violating regulation and reduce expected noncompliance penalties by violating jointly. We consider a case of three German automakers colluding to reduce the effectiveness of emissions control technology. By estimating a structural model of the European automobile industry from 2007 to 2018, we find that collusion lowers expected noncompliance penalties substantially and increases buyer and producer surplus. Due to increased pollution, welfare decreases by € 1.57–5.57 billion. We show how environmental policy design and antitrust play complementary roles in preventing noncompliance.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了企业在环境规制监管不完善的情况下相互串通的行为。企业通过违规排放来增加可变利润，并通过共同违规来降低预期的违规处罚。我们考察了三家德国汽车制造商串通以削弱排放控制技术有效性的案例。通过对2007至2018年欧洲汽车行业的结构模型进行估计，我们发现，串通大幅降低了预期的违规处罚，并增加了买方和生产者剩余。由于污染加剧，社会福利减少了15.7亿至55.7亿欧元。我们说明了环境政策设计与反垄断政策在防止违规方面发挥的互补作用。

title: Political Ideology and U.S. Electric Vehicle Adoption
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: The prospect for electric vehicles (EVs) as a climate change solution hinges on their widespread adoption across political lines. This paper uses county-level data to show that from 2012-2023, about half of all new EV registrations in the U.S. went to the 10% most Democratic counties. This correlation remains largely stable over time, though EV trucks show a lower correlation than other EV types. We also conducted a survey, finding no difference in the ability of Democrats and Republicans to identify EVs. Overall, our results suggest that barriers to widespread U.S. EV adoption may be greater than anticipated. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 电动汽车（EV）作为应对气候变化的解决方案，其前景取决于其能否在不同政治阵营中得到广泛采用。本文利用县级数据表明，2012年至2023年间，美国约一半的新电动汽车登记量流向了民主党得票最高的10%的县。这一相关性在很大程度上随时间保持稳定，不过电动卡车的相关性低于其他类型的电动汽车。我们还进行了一项调查，发现民主党人和共和党人在识别电动汽车方面的能力并无差异。总体而言，我们的结果表明，美国电动汽车广泛普及的障碍可能比预期的更大。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户及发展中国家的居民可以在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文。

title: How Incentive Design Shapes Pass-Through: Evidence from the U.S. Electric Vehicle Market
abstract: We study the pass-through of U.S. state electric vehicle incentives using transaction-level data and a newly assembled dataset of state programs from 2012–2020. Average pass-through is approximately full, but this aggregate estimate conceals substantial heterogeneity. We find that pass-through varies sharply across program designs and buyer characteristics. Transaction prices decrease for purchases and point-of-transaction incentives, resulting in more than full pass-through, while for leases, incentives are substantially eroded by higher transaction prices. Pass-through also varies non-monotonically with buyer income, with no evidence that higher- income buyers capture a larger share of the marginal incentive dollar.
abstract_zh: 我们利用交易层面的数据，以及一套新整理的2012—2020年美国各州项目数据，研究了美国各州电动汽车激励政策的传导率（pass-through）。总体传导率约为完全传导，但这一总体估计掩盖了显著的异质性。我们发现，传导率因项目设计和购买者特征而差异明显。购买环节和交易点激励会降低交易价格，从而产生超过完全传导的效果；而在租赁环节，激励则因较高的交易价格而大幅削弱。传导率还随购买者收入呈非单调变化，没有证据表明高收入购买者能够获得更大比例的边际激励金额。
